en.title: How to Pay Land Development Tax
en.directAnswer: Land development tax is a government land charge. Use the official Ministry of Land service, match the holding and khatian information, pay through the supported method and keep the official receipt or dakhila. Rates and system steps can change, so Justor should re-check the official portal before publication.

atAGlance.whoFor: A landholder wants to understand the official tax/payment process.
atAGlance.mainRule: Land development tax is a government land charge. Use the official Ministry of Land service, match the holding and khati
atAGlance.updateStatus: DYNAMIC DATA: verify current rate tables, portal steps and hotline details on publication day.

en.lawMeaning:

steps: Check the amount shown by the official system.
Resolve record mismatches before paying the wrong holding.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A landholder sees two similar holdings. They should verify the plot and khatian before payment instead of paying the first record that appears.
commonMistakes: treating an old amount as current..
en.specialistTrigger: Large arrears; disputed ownership; record mismatch; tax demand tied to a legal dispute.
